title: Best AI App Builder for Small Businesses in 2026
summary: We scored eight AI app builders on the eight things that matter to a small business running real operations: no per-seat pricing, native booking and customer management, and support you can depend on daily.
body_markdown: Fuzen is a genuine, purpose-built small-business platform with real strengths: 45-plus ready-made industry apps and a one-time-payment model that avoids recurring per-seat fees entirely. Where it falls behind is unification, each app (CRM, HR, ERP) is a separate product, so running a whole business through Fuzen means combining several of them rather than one system.
